triplets.tail: Thermodynamic entropy: Clausius (1865), dS = δQ_rev/T

triplets.head: Six stages of entropy relationship
triplets.tail: Statistical entropy: Boltzmann (1872, 1877) S = k_B ln W; Gibbs S = −k_B Σ p_i ln p_i

triplets.head: Six stages of entropy relationship
triplets.tail: Information entropy: Shannon (1948) H = −Σ p_i log₂ p_i, identical mathematical form to Gibbs

triplets.head: Six stages of entropy relationship
triplets.tail: Jaynes' Maximum Entropy Principle (1957): statistical mechanics as inference; S_thermo = k_B · H_max

triplets.head: Six stages of entropy relationship
triplets.tail: Maxwell's demon thread: Szilard (1929) → Brillouin (1951) → Landauer (1961) → Bennett (1982)

triplets.head: Six stages of entropy relationship
triplets.tail: Experimental verification: Toyabe (2010), Bérut (2012), Koski (2014), Korol (2024)
